q1_issues.issue: The hedge "perhaps" is dropped, so the sealed content asserts the U.S. District Court destination exactly as flatly as the state-court one.
"him" (the party Walker would ask) fills no role on the ask event at all; it appears only as the appeal event's Agent, so the addressee of the asking goes unrecorded.
(Inheritance higher_state_court high) converts the attributive comparative "higher" into the positive property high, which the sentence does not claim (the court is higher than Parrish's, not high).
The class symbol keeps the inflected comparative (higher_state_court) rather than the lemmatized base form the casing/lemmatization rule requires of a class symbol.

q2_gaps: a constituent-scoped epistemic hedge on one conjunct of a coordination ("and perhaps U.S. District Court") — Might/Probably attach to an event, and there is no carrier for hedging a single role filler
attributive comparative with an implicit standard ("a higher state court"); Comparatives & degree covers only the predicative "X is ADJ-er than Y" form

a pre-nominal occupational title ("Defense attorney William Rork"): the courtesy-title rule folds a title into the Name string while the appositive rule makes it a host-tensed typing atom, and nothing says which governs a false title

coordinated oblique objects ("appeal ... to A and B") — the distributive default is stated for coordinated subjects and objects, not for a shared oblique, which the parse instead stacks as two Goal atoms on one event
notes: The nested non-factive seals (say > think > ask), the object-control copy of the appeal Agent, the tenseless embedded appeal with Future only on "would ask", and the projection of Walker/ruling/U.S. District Court typing atoms are all handled correctly. (Possession sk_ruling_1 parrish) is projected outside the seal although the projection rule names only Member/Name typing atoms.
